description: This file defines utilities and interface functions for integrating ucode (microcode or scripting engine) with hostapd, including function declarations for creating VM instances, executing scripts, managing registry entries, and specific ucode functions like printf and sha1.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_create_vm
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ucode virtual machine instance.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_run
methods.description: Runs a ucode script given its filename.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_call_prepare
methods.description: Prepares to call a ucode function by its filename.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_call
methods.description: Calls a ucode function with specified number of arguments.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_free_vm
methods.description: Frees and cleans up the ucode virtual machine instance.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_global_init
methods.description: Initializes a global ucode resource with a given name and type.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_registry_add
methods.description: Adds a value to the ucode registry.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_registry_get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the ucode registry by index.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_registry_remove
methods.description: Removes a value from the ucode registry by index.

methods.name: uc_wpa_printf
methods.description: Custom printf function exposed to ucode scripts.

methods.name: uc_wpa_getpid
methods.description: Returns the process ID in ucode scripts.

methods.name: uc_wpa_sha1
methods.description: Computes SHA1 hash within ucode scripts.

methods.name: uc_wpa_freq_info
methods.description: Provides frequency information in ucode scripts.
